mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a leading indicator of equity returns; a lower rate is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is observed.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market that signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) and rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 215) indicates a strong economy with moderate inflation, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.2 AND CPIAUCSL > 215.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 0.1% rise in FEDFUNDS over 3 months), increased borrowing costs and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 500) indicates a weakening real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: The level of employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000,000 persons is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS is observed.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 600) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 360000) indicates robust economic growth, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 600 AND RSAFS > 360000.
